envelope.description: Derive the single review unit for a route without a Plan

body.title: Derive the single review unit for a route without a Plan
body.summary: For a route without a Plan make prepareReviewPacket return one unit whose id is the BUILD's task id, with title, summary and acceptance checks taken from the route's design record (the LLD's acceptance mapping, the ISSUE's fix intent, or the BUILD focus) and size from the number of selected changed files (S for one or two, M for three to eight, L above); refuse a Plan-less route whose BUILD has more than one task.
acceptanceChecks: The unit's id is the BUILD task id and its checks come from the LLD acceptance mapping, the ISSUE fix intent or the BUILD focus for the three Plan-less routes
One or two selected files give size S, three to eight M and nine or more L
A Plan-less route whose BUILD has more than one task is refused, and every submitted change and test can be attributed to the unit by deriveTaskAssignments
